headline: David Jones Collapse Leaves Creditors Facing Debts Past $419M
summary: Suppliers to collapsed Australian department store chain David Jones will remain unpaid until next year as outstanding debts exceed $419 million, with total liabilities to lenders, landlords, and staff estimated to surpass $500 million.
why: David Jones is one of Australia's oldest and most iconic luxury department store chains, owned by private equity.

impacts.name: Australian Retail
impacts.why: Unpaid vendor debts and large liabilities from a department store failure create credit stress for retail suppliers.
